阈值与人工吸收：把诊断写进报告: Thresholds and artificial absorption: include diagnostics in the report

保持轴向晶场、SOC与温度不变，比较x与z偏振、45°叠加及零场圆二色性。: Keep the axial crystal field, SOC, and temperature fixed while comparing x and z polarizations, a 45° superposition, and zero-field circular dichroism.

不附加反幺正对称性；空间射影表示的二维性与自旋 Kramers 机制须区分。: No antiunitary symmetry is imposed. Distinguish two-dimensional spatial projective representations from the spin-based Kramers mechanism.

同一局域关联体系的自旋与电荷探针: Spin and charge probes of the same locally correlated system
该二聚体只说明不同算符探测不同激发；不能把曲线直接标成真实中子、RIXS或光学实: This dimer illustrates that different operators probe different excitations. Its curves are not actual neutron, RIXS, or optical cross sections, and two sites do not predict long-range magnetic order.
用局域轨道与振子说明电子离域时也能携带振动云，比较无耦合与有限耦合。: Use local orbitals and oscillators to show that delocalized electrons can still carry a vibrational cloud; compare zero and finite coupling.
界面反演破缺与 Rashba 型项: Broken inversion at interfaces and Rashba-type terms
约化k、示意系数与同宇称真实自旋双态；不是特定界面的拟合能带。: Reduced k coordinates, illustrative coefficients, and a physical-spin doublet of equal parity; these are not fitted bands of a specific interface.
将同一空间轨道与自旋单重态组合，解释两电子为何可占据同一空间轨道。: Combine a common spatial orbital with a spin singlet to explain why two electrons can occupy the same spatial orbital.
a、b 为正交教学轨道；没有使用真实 H₂ 的非正交轨道积分或势能面。: a and b are orthogonal teaching orbitals. No nonorthogonal orbital integrals or potential-energy surfaces of actual H₂ are used.
构造对称与混合子空间，对照 SU(2) 耦合和 Young 对称化。: Construct symmetric and mixed-symmetry subspaces, comparing SU(2) coupling with Young symmetrization.
观察平面方向场的绕转，讨论易平面约束与缺陷核心。: Observe winding of an in-plane direction field and discuss easy-plane constraints and defect cores.
比较带箭头的矢量与正反等价的指向矢，使用双角场读取半圈转角。: Compare directed vectors with head–tail-equivalent directors; use a double-angle field to identify half-turn rotations.
分别翻转外磁场和磁畴，追踪交换激励与读出通道的比较条件。: Reverse the external magnetic field and magnetic domain separately, tracking the conditions for comparisons with interchanged drive and readout channels.
一偶一奇为抽象近稳态变量；不是电荷和能量这两个均偶的通道。: The even and odd variables are abstract near-steady-state variables, not the charge and energy channels, which are both even.
现象学Markov通道，不从晶格对称性直接推出退相干速率，不模拟非Markov浴: Phenomenological Markovian channels: dephasing rates are not derived directly from lattice symmetry, and non-Markovian baths are not simulated.
仅采用C₄ᵥ子群与四个标量轨道。真实平方平面配位可有更高对称；本例没有中心原子轨: Only a C₄ᵥ subgroup and four scalar orbitals are used. Actual square-planar coordination may have higher symmetry. This example includes no central-atom orbitals, chemical overlaps, inversion parities, or material fitting.

比较 3×3 矩形超胞与指数为 3 的最小平移胞，使用 Fourier 权重预测: Compare a 3×3 rectangular supercell with the minimal translation cell of index 3. Use Fourier weights to predict satellite intensities before and after phase changes.
螺旋链：相同平移相位、不同旋转轴: Screw chain: the same translation phase, different rotation axes
构造的是 {C₂x|a_x/2} 的合法教学表示；未指定完整材料空间群，也不是所: This constructs a valid teaching representation of {C₂x|a_x/2}; it specifies neither a complete material space group nor a classification of every screw order.
给 A/B 加相反位点势或给自旋加沿轴磁场，分别检验 G、T 协变；用全线下界完: Add opposite A/B site potentials or an axial spin field and test G and T covariance separately. Complete the minimal-symmetry-breaking challenge using a bound valid along the full line.
从反向磁矩到成对的磁激发: From opposite moments to paired magnetic excitations
内置 Einstein 频率、静态能量与参数是原创教学构造，不是某个材料的第一性: The built-in Einstein frequencies, static energies, and parameters are original teaching constructions, not first-principles data for a material.
把既有NiO结构和磁性材料案例连接到局域d轨道分组，区分单电子晶场图与d⁸多重态: Connect the existing NiO structure and magnetic-material cases to local d-orbital groups, distinguishing single-electron crystal-field diagrams from d⁸ multiplets.
Q₂/Q₃是无量纲约化坐标；不是自动生成的标准晶体模式，也不是从真实结构拟合的g: Q₂/Q₃ are reduced dimensionless coordinates, not automatically generated standard crystal modes. The g/K parameters are not fitted from an actual structure. Nuclear kinetic energy, dynamic JT effects, SOC, and transition temperatures are excluded.
从已有极性畸变和六方向畴，选择相反两畴建立一维连续壁。: Starting from the existing polar distortion and six directional domains, select two opposite domains to construct a one-dimensional continuous wall.
用有限链能谱、LDOS和投影密度区分界面与边界的贡献。: Use finite-chain energy spectra, LDOS, and projector densities to distinguish interface and boundary contributions.
固定跃迁和长度，只在中心两格点加入势，比较手征残差和LDOS。: Keep hopping and chain length fixed. Add a potential only at the central two sites and compare the chiral-symmetry residual and LDOS.
二维各向异性带：从张量到热电符号: Two-dimensional anisotropic band: from tensors to thermoelectric signs
不拟合具体材料；给定跃迁和常数τ，忽略Berry/Hall与相互作用修正。: No specific material is fitted. Hoppings and constant τ are supplied, while Berry/Hall and interaction corrections are neglected.
先运行低温粗网格反例，再增加温度或网格，检查局部收敛与电子热导边界。: First run the low-temperature coarse-mesh counterexample, then raise the temperature or refine the mesh to examine local convergence and the limits of electronic thermal conductivity.
单轨道、自旋单态、输入配对幅度；没有自洽配对机制或材料临界温度预测，不直接等同某: A single orbital, spin-singlet pairing, and an input pairing amplitude. There is no self-consistent pairing mechanism or material Tc prediction, and this is not directly identified with a particular cuprate.
四方 4mm 相的张量模型，不计算相变温度或真实光学系数；仅整体χ反号的候选在独: A tensor model for the tetragonal 4mm phase, without calculating transition temperatures or actual optical coefficients. Candidates differing only by an overall sign of χ are indistinguishable in independent intensity plots.
对比两种微观扰动，再用真正删除轨道的空位预设检查谱权重求和规则。: Compare two microscopic perturbations, then test spectral-weight sum rules with the vacancy preset that actually removes an orbital.
从非零候选D出发加入键中心反演，逐条观察反对称交换被去除。: Start from a nonzero candidate D and add bond-center inversion; observe term by term how antisymmetric exchange is removed.
所选镜面是输入的理想局域对称性，没有从任意CIF提取交换路径；图中的D大小不是第: The selected mirrors are ideal local input symmetries; exchange paths are not extracted from arbitrary CIF files. The plotted D magnitude is not a first-principles prediction.
在同一个二聚体上换坐标与端点标签，用量子能谱校验它们描述同一物理相互作用。: Change coordinates and endpoint labels for the same dimer, then use its quantum spectrum to verify that both describe the same physical interaction.
立方母体的三个切面: Three surface cuts of a cubic parent
简单立方单原子母体；不是特定元素表面的弛豫结果。: A monatomic simple-cubic parent, not a relaxed surface of a specific element.
区分各侧自身的对称与整体界面的共同操作。: Distinguish each side's own symmetry from the operations common to the complete interface.
N=3–5 的 AKLT 链，不把小链谱当作热力学极限的实验谱。: An AKLT chain with N=3–5; its small-chain spectrum is not an experimental spectrum in the thermodynamic limit.
可解析二维教学模型: An analytically tractable two-dimensional teaching model
页面未导入或拟合Fe的Wannier矩阵元；所有可交互数值均来自QWZ，不能标为: No Fe Wannier matrix elements are imported or fitted. All interactive values come from QWZ and must not be labeled as predictions or experimental data for iron.
只借用铜氧体系讨论中的单轨道有效模型动机；本站四站点链没有显式氧p轨道、二维Cu: Only the motivation for a single-orbital effective model is borrowed from cuprate physics. This four-site chain has no explicit oxygen p orbitals, two-dimensional CuO₂ structure, or charge-transfer energy; it predicts neither cuprate magnetic order nor superconducting or Mott transitions.
交错位能是外加的单轨道模型参数；它不等于真实配体到金属的电荷转移能，也没有自洽屏: The staggered potential is an externally specified single-orbital model parameter, not an actual ligand-to-metal charge-transfer energy. Self-consistent screening, relaxation, and material fitting are excluded.
零温简并基态按所选粒子数扇区等权平均；这不是温度扫描，也不代表自发选择的磁性态。: At zero temperature, average equally over the degenerate ground states in the selected particle-number sector. This is neither a temperature scan nor a spontaneously selected magnetic state. A finite cluster alone cannot establish thermodynamic long-range order.
